blocks.title: Free vibrations (azad jhoolna)
blocks.text: Jab koi body kisi external force (bahar ki force) ki interference (dakhal) ke baghair apni natural frequency (apni asal frequency) par jhoole to kehte hain ke woh free vibrations kar raha hai.

Misal: Fig. 14.12 ka simple pendulum, jab use mean position se thora sa hata kar chhora jaye, apni natural frequency par azadi se jhoolta hai; yeh frequency sirf us ki length (lambai) par depend karti hai.

blocks.alt: Support par O se latakta simple pendulum. Bob A, mean position B aur C par dikhaya gaya hai; A aur C ke darmiyan dotted arc aur teer jo B se guzarte hue dono taraf jhoolna dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.12: Simple pendulum ki free oscillation (kitab ki Figure 14.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Free oscillations mein body ki total energy constant rehti hai, yani energy conserved (bachi) rehti hai. Hum assume (farz) karte hain ke koi resistance force (rukawat wali force, jaise air friction (hawa ki ragar)) nahi, is liye amplitude bhi constant rehta hai.
Agar azadi se jhoolte system par bahar se force lagayi jaye to forced vibrations hoti hain. Misal: jab jhoole ko baar baar dhakka diya jaye to forced vibrations paida hoti hain (Fig. 14.13).

blocks.alt: Jhoole ke do lamhe. Har aik mein aik aadmi jhoole ke peeche khara us par bethi larki ko dhakka deta hai; doosre mein jhoola aage ja chuka hai aur woh baazu phaila kar ab bhi dhakka de raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.13: Jhoole ki forced oscillations ki misal (kitab ki Figure 14.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Bhari machinery chalne se factory ke farsh ka thartharana forced vibration ki misal hai. Ek aur misal: string instruments (taar wale saaz) ke lakri ke boards (sound boards) bajne par unchi awaz paida karte hain; taar ki thartharahat board ko zabardasti thartharati hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Guitar ki taar, bajti ghanti (bell), atoms ka jhoolna, bridge (pul) ka thartharana aur building (imarat) ka hilna: kitab inhen free oscillations ki misalein batati hai.

blocks.prompt: Jhoole par baithe bachche ko ek dafa dhakka de kar chhor diya jaye to yeh free oscillation hai ya forced? Aur agar har chakkar par dhakka diya jaye?
blocks.explanation: Ek dafa dhakka de kar chhorna free oscillation hai; har chakkar par dhakka dena forced oscillation hai.

header: Ek dafa dhakka de kar chhorna
rows: Jhoola apni natural frequency par jhoolta hai
Jhoola dhakkon ki (driving) frequency par jhoolta hai
Friction se amplitude aahista aahista kam hota hai aur jhoola ruk jata hai
Dhakke energy dete rehte hain, is liye amplitude bana rehta hai

items: Free oscillation: natural frequency par, bahar ki force ke baghair; friction na ho to energy aur amplitude constant.
Forced oscillation: bahar ki periodic force se, jaise jhoole ko baar baar dhakka ya machinery se farsh ka thartharana.
